name: TLE2071
full_name: Excalibur Low-Noise High-Speed JFET-Input Operational Amplifier
description: Single JFET-input op-amp from TI's Excalibur line -- a higher-performance, pin-compatible upgrade over the TL071: 10MHz GBW, faster slew, lower offset, and inputs that work up to the positive rail. For high-speed or low-noise single-op-amp stages (data acquisition, DMM/scope front-ends, portable audio). TLE2072 dual, TLE2074 quad.

pins.name: OFFSET NULL
pins.description: offset null (N1). Exposed only on the ceramic JG package; the plastic P (PDIP) / D (SOIC) packages mark pin 1 as NC

pins.name: OFFSET NULL
pins.description: offset null (N2). Ceramic JG package only; NC on the plastic P/D packages

extra.supply: wider rails, dynamic signal range to +-19V
extra.note: common-mode input range extends to the positive supply rail

typical_application: High-speed data acquisition, DMM/oscilloscope front-ends, low-power/portable audio, precision single-op-amp stages. A performance drop-in for a TL071 socket (same 8-pin single in/out/power pinout).
gotchas: OFFSET NULL is exposed only on the ceramic JG package; on the common plastic P (PDIP) / D (SOIC) packages pins 1, 5, 8 are NC -- leave them open
JFET input reaches the positive rail but not the negative one; keep signals off the V- rail
